scope: Fadia A0 full-health six-hit initial Burst and Eternal Waltz equipped HP/Mental effects
decision: One native UltraSkill1 primary, four UltraSkill2 children and one UltraSkill3 child use admitted native HP coefficients and live runtime Max HP. Ordered coincident impacts on target zero are a timing hypothesis. Admission requires A0 and full HP, so lost-HP threshold enhancement and actual healing are not reached. Lilith lasts five seconds from admission and ends on field exit; unmodeled form inputs reject.
weapon: Eternal Waltz adds buff_Arachne_Hp to native base HP in the additive HP-percent domain before integer settlement. Successful wearer Ultimate admission refreshes a wearer-only additive Mental bonus for ten seconds before same-time hits. Switching preserves it; exact expiry precedes hits. Mental and Psyche are distinct native packet types: Arachne's English Mental and Chinese 心灵 description agree with PSYCHICALLY, while PSYCHE uses 魂属性 and does not receive this bonus. Release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.
independent_oracles: Reference guide level-one initial Burst display 3.9% + 1.2% x4 + 6.3% Max HP matches the native HP arrays. All nine source coordinates are checked in native projection tests; the extracted Neverness Burst stats list is empty and supplies description/count evidence only.

At runtime Max HP 10000, level-one Burst totals 1500 Mental damage, bypassing target defense; level eight totals 2590. Current HP is an admission condition, not a scaling input. ATK/DEF changes cannot affect it.

An isolated base HP 10000 with only R1 passive HP yields 12000 Max HP and 1980 Burst damage with the 10% Mental bonus; R5 yields 13200 and 2336.4 with 18%. A real equipped build additionally includes the weapon's native static HPMaxUp stat; these isolated examples exclude that separate stat.

Refinements 1-5 select HP ratios 0.20/0.23/0.26/0.29/0.32 and Mental ratios 0.10/0.12/0.14/0.16/0.18. At fixed base HP 10000, R5 minus R1 adds exactly 1200 HP; adding another 20% HP adds 2000, proving additivity.
checks: Native content suite and static projection data tests pass; causal weapon checks cover admission, wearer scope, Mental/Psyche filtering, refresh, switches and equal-time expiry.

Fadia native tests cover pure HP source coordinates, six packet identities, max-HP scaling, caller replacement, strict declarations, full-health/A0 rejection and Lilith expiry. Rebuilt CLI/WASM/Worker public Eternal Waltz runs pass full report parity at all five refinements; Fadia Normal and Adler DEF regression scenarios pass. TypeScript, Rust/web formatting and production build pass.

Clippy passes with only collapsible_if, drop_non_drop and filter_next disabled: diagnostics in unchanged Nanally, the existing Fireflies hit callback and Lunarphase test were confirmed in HEAD. Unmodified strict clippy still fails on those diagnostics; new needless_borrow diagnostics were corrected.

Dynamic HP percent/flat modifiers reject when reached by HP-scaled delivery; geometry, animation intervals and multi-target coverage remain unsupported.
